findings.description: The overlaps function returns True when two half‑open intervals touch at an endpoint. For half‑open intervals [start, end), touching endpoints should not overlap. The implementation uses <= instead of <, causing false positives.
findings.evidence: overlaps((1, 3), (3, 5)) returns True, but the correct result is False.

review.summary: Candidate implementation incorrectly treats touching half-open intervals as overlapping, violating the contract.
